summary.headline: Appeal for Ptolemy’s Quadripartitum
summary.text: Dedication praising Johannes Schöner’s arguments on ancient house division, promising an emended and expanded Albumasar, and urging the addressee to publish the complete Ptolemaic Quadripartitum with commentaries. Signed by Philipp at Nuremberg on 1 April 1546.
